Upon selection of A-GRA, the Mission Planner Autonomy UI must dynamically reconfigure connection parameter fields (e.g., IPs, Ports, Serial) to match the A- GRA interface format and auto -populate with appropriate default values. Technical Background and Contractual History This is a new requirement (Describe Technical Background below) This is a follow-on requirement Technical Background: The below referenced data is necessary in order to continue our access to data on hospital systems on a timely basis as needed for Reports to Congress assigned to ASPE and required under Section 109 of the No Surprises Act. Contractual History ASPE has purchased this data annually for several consecutive years from this vendor 3. Compatibility or Performance Characteristics for Supply of Service Required Features & Benefits of the acquisition: ASPE conducts various health policy studies that require information on provider market structure, including hospital concentration. The AHA’s Annual Survey Database is the only national database

ase order would allow ASPE to update this information to the latest year available. The AHA database is the only national hospital-level dataset that is updated on an annual basis and that provides the data necessary many projects at ASPE including hospital system market structure and hospital staffing capacity. The database includes up to 1,000 data fields on the characteristics of approximately 6,500 hospitals including organizational structure, facility and service lines, inpatient and outpatient utilization, physician arrangements, staffing, corporate and purchasing affiliations, teaching status, geographic indicators, and cross-reference identifiers (e.g., Medicare Provider Number and National Provider Identifier). Specific fields required for many ASPE projects include hospital county, ZIP code, service category, profit status, number of admissions, and system membership and detailed staffing data. The contractor shall supply a dataset with all these elements to ASPE. Compatibility/Performance Requirements 5. Market research indicates that no other solution fulfills these specific requirements without significant impacts on schedule, costs, and operations. Therefore, Crestron remains the only provider capable of meeting the technical and compatibility needs for this upgrade. 2. What is the impact to the government if another vendor/brand is used? Include any dollar, schedule, or compatibility impacts if possible. Utilizing a different vendor or brand could result in significant schedule delays, as the government would need to evaluate, integrate, and train personnel on unfamiliar equipment. Previous experience indicates that such processes can considerably slow project progress. Additionally, switching to an alternative brand may introduce compatibility issues with the existing Crestron-based infrastructure, necessitating further technical adjustments, extended testing, and new approval procedures before the system can operate correctly. These challenges are likely to increase costs, compromise reliability, and disrupt operational continuity, making alternative brands both time-consuming and financially burdensome for the government.
